title: Abbas kaha'n ho aajao
body:
thi ahle haram ki bas ye sada
imdaad hamari kar jao
abbas kaha'n ho aajao
ghamgeen bahot hai ye manzar
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh kaise uthaye laashe pisar
jaane se tumhari tooti kamar
ab dene sahara aajao
ye sounch ke jaa'n wo khoti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aisi bhi qismat hoti hai
sar dekh ke zainab roti hai
chadar to behen ko dilwao
wo bhai mera jo lashkar tha
<<DIVIDER>>
thi jisse dharas zainab ki
ab ahle haram ka koi nahi
ham kaise jiyenge batlao
koofe me apne qatil ki
<<DIVIDER>>
khulwai thi mushke'n baba ne
ab qaide rasan me zainab hai
shanou se rasan to khulwao
be sar hai sakina ka jo pidar
<<DIVIDER>>
wo roti khadi hai lashe par
ab taza yateemi hai daawar
pursa dene ko aajao
